name: Textarea
description: A multiline text field that grows with its content and counts characters.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the field. Replaced by the error while the field is invalid.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown under the field while it is invalid. Defaults to the browser's validation message.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint shown while the field is empty.

props.name: autoGrow
props.description: Grow with the content instead of showing a scrollbar.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Stop growing at this many lines and scroll instead.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Character limit. Also turns the counter on.

props.name: showCount
props.description: Show the counter in the bottom right of the field. It turns yuzu at 90% of the limit and camellia at the limit.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Shows the camellia border and the error message.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the field and dims it to 50%.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: The text can be selected but not changed. Shown on a muted fill.

props.name: fieldClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the outlined box.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components TextField (value, onChange, name, validate...).
